thread:
jen: Heads-up from Enterprise Ops — they want auditable, verifiable exports for legal holds (8yr). Need concrete ACs and a selling plan.
omar: We can produce signed bundles (NDJSON + manifest) and optionally tie signatures to customer KMS.
lina: Clarify: do auditors need on-line searchable logs or offline signed snapshots? This changes cost massively.
sec-bot: security: BYOK handshake required if customer keys are used. Must capture key id, algorithm, and rotation epoch in manifest.
ryan: Ops: cheap path = cold snapshots + on-demand bundle assembly. Propose SLAs: <6h for <50GB, 24h for larger.
jen: Product ask: draft ACs (manifest schema, redaction modes, verification CLI, KMS attestation), pricing (per-GB archive + per-export fee), and contract language for key custody.
omar: Also include an export-preview checksum step so customers verify before final sign.
lina: I'll draft PRD + ACs and loop legal.
jen: Good. Sales wants a templated quote for next week. Thank you.
